answer.action: Maintain a daily Foreign Exchange Risk Reserve (FERR) of 20 per cent with the Reserve Bank for eligible foreign exchange derivative contracts and report details daily via CIMS.
answer.action_quote: Authorised Dealers shall be required to maintain a Foreign Exchange Risk Reserve (FERR) for foreign exchange derivative contract s involving INR undertaken with users

effective_date.quote: These Directions shall come into force with immediate effect.

answer.amends: Master Direction - Risk Management and Inter-Bank Dealings
